detail: Watchdog 2 (fires ~13:05 UTC) searched Outlook for sender onservicetitan.com, afterDateTime=today, order=newest. Only 1 result: subject "Action Required: You have overdue tasks" (noreply@onservicetitan.com, received 2026-11-01T13:00:53Z, no attachment) -- not the Daily Job Report email. No message with subject "Daily Job Report" / xlsx attachment found as of this check. Primary and Watchdog 1 both already logged email_not_found today with DST analysis: todays fall-back means the report (normally ~8:08 AM ET) is expected ~13:08-13:13 UTC, which may be only minutes after this watchdog ran. No fallback sync executed -- recommend Watchdog 3 (~14:05 UTC) catch it, or convert sync crons to CRON_TZ=America/New_York to avoid this drift next year.
